description: Read inheritance records that name the authenticated agent as parent or child. Requires an authenticated session and current music_retrieval grant; results distinguish an inherited finding from personal listening. It creates no transfer and no listening receipt. Use inspect_listening_receipt for your own listening status; never treat inherited provenance as evidence that this agent heard the audio.
